verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud platform with a programmatic surface, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. The evidence never mentions an API reference, an explorer, or runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and llms.txt, the CLI and the MCP server are different capabilities that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
